description: Implementation of the ProductImageService interface, providing functionality for managing product images including adding, retrieving, and deleting images within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductImageServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class that manages product images, extends generic entity service, handles image addition, retrieval, and deletion

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a ProductImage by its ID

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Add multiple product images to a product, converting image input streams into content files

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Add a single product image, saving it to storage and database

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new ProductImage or update an existing one, including its descriptions

methods.name: addProductImageDescription
methods.description: Associate a description with a product image and update the entity

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieve a product image in a specific size as an OutputContentFile, given a ProductImage object

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieve a product image based on store code, product code, filename, and size

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Retrieve all images associated with a specific product

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Remove a product image from storage and delete its record
